review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including product managers, data engineers, and software developers—to define requirements, experiment with new approaches, and integrate models into production systems. Qualifications Strong foundation in Computer Science and Software Development, including data structures, algorithms, version control, and production-grade coding practices. Expertise in Pattern Recognition and Neural Networks, with experience designing, training, and optimizing models for real-world applications. Hands-on experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), including modern architectures, language models, and text processing pipelines. Proficiency with common AI/ML tools and frameworks (e.g., Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Docker, cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure).
